2. Text readability — "Everything Free — For a Limited Time" - Font size may be too small for mobile readability (severity: MED)  
3. Horizontal overflow — No visible overflow; content fits 390px viewport (CLEAN)  
4. Layout breaks — No awkward stacking/gaps; elements align vertically (CLEAN)  
5. Navigation — Hamburger menu visible (top right) - Appears functional (CLEAN)  
6. Forms — No visible forms; "Try It Free" button is a single CTA (CLEAN)  
7. Modals — No modals present (CLEAN)  
8. Whitespace — "Try It Free" button has balanced padding; no cramping (CLEAN)  
9. Readability — Text contrast is sufficient (dark text on light/dark backgrounds); no cut-off text (CLEAN)  
10. Buttons — "Try It Free" button and chat icon have adequate spacing (CLEAN)
